title: fix: only team tracking issues parent dev issues
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #15335.

- Only `TRACKING` issues opened by team members are offered to the classifier as parents for Dev issues. Community epics also carry `TRACKING` (e.g. #14763); the relabel run picked it as the parent for four internal issues, which the Support project's sub-issue workflow then pulled into Support
- Issues opened by CI bots (e.g. github-actions failure reports) route to Dev instead of Support. The Discord relay bot still counts as the person it relays

gist.headline: Parents stay in the hive
gist.blurb: The issue gardener now checks who planted the tracking marker before filing it under Dev. CI reports also find their way to the right workbench.
gist.summary: Updated the GitHub project manager so only TRACKING issues opened by team members can become parents of Dev issues, while CI-bot failure reports route to Dev and Discord-relayed reports retain their original human author.
gist.impact: Internal Dev issues now avoid being attached to community TRACKING epics and accidentally pulled into Support, keeping project workflows neatly separated.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy issue-triage garden: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener hat, sorts labeled TRACKING seed packets into a Dev planter while a friendly little CI robot carries a failure-report note to the correct bench. Community and Support planters remain clearly separate, with code-vines and flowers showing orderly routing.
